answer: The sable holds work receipts rather than names, so the prism of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the falcon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, idle agents bleed standing.
